FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: The course this instance belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity name.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity description.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: conversationstyle
FIELD.COMMENT: Didactic conversation style 1-5 (Geschlossen..Offen).

FIELD.NAME: dqr
FIELD.COMMENT: Difficulty level 3-7.

FIELD.NAME: industry
FIELD.COMMENT: Domain / field of expertise; null or empty means unset.

FIELD.NAME: taxonomylevels
FIELD.COMMENT: Enabled Bloom taxonomy levels for practice questions (CSV of 1..3).

FIELD.NAME: questiontypes
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON map difficulty grade (1..3) to allowed question widget types; null or empty means plugin defaults.

FIELD.NAME: operators
FIELD.COMMENT: Operator taxonomy for practice questions: standard or ihk.

FIELD.NAME: anticheat
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the learner may not ask the chat about the current practice question.

FIELD.NAME: learntempo
FIELD.COMMENT: Learning pace 0.1-2 steering XP growth; 1 is recommended.

FIELD.NAME: askenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the Ask a question mode is available to learners.

FIELD.NAME: testenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the Test knowledge mode is available to learners.

FIELD.NAME: buildenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the Build knowledge mode is available to learners.

FIELD.NAME: gifenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether Build knowledge widgets may include GIF animations.

FIELD.NAME: learningmethod
FIELD.COMMENT: Didactic concept of the Build knowledge mode (learning_method).

FIELD.NAME: interactiontype
FIELD.COMMENT: Who shapes the brain's output (interaction_type): trainer-driven for text cards, ai-driven lets the agent send interactive web cards.

FIELD.NAME: completionprogress
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion rule: the activity completes once the learner's progress reaches this percentage; 0 switches the rule off.

TABLE.NAME: tarsus_inclusions
TABLE.COMMENT: Tracks which indexed resources a teacher has included in a specific tarsus activity instance.

FIELD.NAME: tarsusid
FIELD.COMMENT: Link to tarsus table.

FIELD.NAME: resourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Namespaced resource id from local_tarsus.

TABLE.NAME: tarsus_progress
TABLE.COMMENT: The latest experience, learning-unit and progress figures the brain reported per learner and activity; the source of the gradebook grade and the completion rule.

FIELD.NAME: tarsusid
FIELD.COMMENT: Link to tarsus table.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner.

FIELD.NAME: earnedxp
FIELD.COMMENT: earnedExperiencePoints (Test knowledge).

FIELD.NAME: earnedunits
FIELD.COMMENT: earnedLearningUnits (Build knowledge).

FIELD.NAME: practiceprogress
FIELD.COMMENT: practiceProgress in percent.

FIELD.NAME: learnprogress
FIELD.COMMENT: learnProgress in percent.

FIELD.NAME: progress
FIELD.COMMENT: The brain's overall progress in percent.
